name: 宝可梦 巅峰之路
summary: Pokémon: Path to the Peak is an original series that brings the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) to life as you’ve never seen before. Set in the compelling world of competitive Pokémon TCG play, it’s the story of our hero, Ava, who discovers her natural talent alongside her partner Pokémon, Oddish.With the support of family, community, and newfound friends, she sets her goal to rise to the very top. Follow along with her journey in the four-part original video series.
